letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise—whether it’s the glitter of Dubai’s skyline or the gentle breeze over Ahmedabad’s lakes—reminds me how lucky I am to share it with you, my cutie. As the calendar flips and the world swirls, my love for you stays steady, bright, and ever‑playful. I cherish our laughter, our quiet moments, and the promise that each day brings another reason to fall deeper for you. Until we’re together again, keep this heart of mine close.
poem:
Across dunes and rivers we roam,  
Hand in hand, we’ve built our home.  
Your smile, my compass, pure and true,  
Forever, love, I’m bound to you.
